title: Terminal

status.count: {count} of {max} terminal open | {count} of {max} terminals open

new.title: New terminal
new.intro: Choose whom the shell runs as. Opening a terminal may ask for your password again.
new.nobody: There is nobody a terminal can run as.
new.step: Open a login shell as {user} in {home}
new.rootWarning: A root terminal can change anything on the server: every command runs with full privileges.
new.nobodySites: There is no site owner to open a terminal as. Terminals as root and other users are for administrators.
new.sitesOnly: Only site owners are listed: terminals as root and other users are for administrators.
new.userWarning: This user may be able to use sudo, which makes the terminal as powerful as a root terminal.

user.rootOff: Turned off: allow root terminals first

root.label: Root terminals
root.enableText: Administrators will be able to open terminals as root, with full control of the server. Turn this on only while you need it.
root.locked: The server's configuration does not allow root terminals, so they stay off.

close.title: Close {name}?
close.text: The shell ends, together with the programs it runs.

empty.title: No terminal is open
empty.text: Open a terminal to run commands on the server as a site owner or another user.
empty.textSites: Open a terminal to run commands on the server as a site owner.

endedNotice: This terminal has ended: the shell exited, or the server closed it (it does when your account's role or password changes).
hint: Terminals keep running for 5 minutes after you leave this page.
focusHint: Press Esc and then Tab to move out of the terminal.

scheme.label: Terminal colour scheme
scheme.note: Schemes with a light and a dark version follow the panel's mode. Only Cairn's colours are checked to stay readable; the others keep their authors' colours.
scheme.saveFailed: Could not save the terminal colour scheme to your account.

snippets.title: Saved commands
snippets.sheetIntro: Saved commands are kept for your account and pasted into the terminal in front.
snippets.emptyText: Save commands you run often, then paste or run them in any terminal.
snippets.pasteHint: Paste into the terminal without running
snippets.runHint: Paste into the terminal and press Enter
snippets.commandHint: {size} of {max}. Lines run one after the other; tabs are allowed, other control characters are not.
snippets.commandTooLong: The command must be at most {size}.
snippets.commandControl: The command may not contain control characters other than tabs and line breaks.
snippets.pasteNote: Paste puts the command at the prompt for you to check; Run also presses Enter.
snippets.deleteText: The saved command is removed from your account. Terminals are not affected.
snippets.unbracketedText: This shell runs each line as soon as it is pasted, without waiting for Enter.
